summary: Phase 2 end-to-end verification (backend + frontend). New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_cart_join.py — 22/22 PASS covering: (1) Terms & Conditions enforcement at registration; (2) Registration creates PENDING user without incrementing sponsor.direct_referrals_count; (3) Cart join-gate: unpaid user gets 403 on non-hamper add, 200 on joining hamper add; (4) Cart CRUD (GET/add/update/remove/clear) + stock over-limit rejection; (5) /api/site/delivery-config returns dynamic values used by /orders/create shipping calc; (6) Joining kit order + /orders/verify-payment activates buyer, increments sponsor paid count, logs commission_held for ineligible sponsor; (7) After joining, user can add non-hamper products and CANNOT re-add hamper (400); (8) Full income-activation flow — sponsor with 3 paid direct refs becomes income_active and receives L1=₹1200 commission on the 3rd paid buyer; (9) Admin pages /admin, /admin/inventory, /admin/accounts, /admin/audit-logs, /admin/sliders, /admin/reels all load without errors. Frontend Playwright verified: Register T&C flow (checkbox unchecked initial, submit-disabled, terms-modal open + accept auto-checks, submit enabled + successful register); Cart page shows join-notice, empty state, all data-testids (subtotal/gst/shipping/total/incr/decr/remove/checkout/clear); ProductDetail non-hamper add-to-cart on unpaid user redirects to /hampers; hamper add-to-cart works and Proceed to Checkout navigates to /checkout with correct totals (₹7,200 subtotal + ₹360 GST + FREE shipping = ₹7,560). Found 1 minor backend field-omission bug (`income_active` missing from public_user output) which forced test to verify activation indirectly via commission_wallet — main agent should add `income_active` to public_user response.

minor.issue: public_user() at /app/backend/server.py L83 does NOT include `income_active` (nor `joining_paid_at`, `income_activated_at`). DB correctly stores income_active=True after 3 paid refs, but frontend cannot detect it via /auth/me. Frontend uses `is_joining_paid` only — but for banner/UX distinguishing 'joined-but-not-yet-earning' vs 'income-active', the flag is needed.
Response omits GST/shipping/total — Cart.jsx computes them client-side via useCart().delivery. Fine as-is, but consider a single server-side compute endpoint for consistency with /orders/create.
Was reported broken in iteration_3 (missing route decorator). Not re-verified in this iteration — main agent should confirm the fix is in place. Also /api/admin/kyc/{id} PUT NameError.
If product_id doesn't exist in cart AND qty>0, silently no-ops (nothing gets added). Should either 404 or upsert. Currently returns 200 with unchanged items.

issues: Header/subheader present but no hamper cards visible below it — seed locks all except HMP-JOINING-7200 which IS active. Only 1 hamper should show but seems missing from grid on some viewport sizes. Recommend verifying hamper card rendering when only joining kit is active.

action_items: Add `income_active`, `joining_paid_at`, `income_activated_at` fields to public_user() in /app/backend/server.py L83 so frontend can show 'Income Active' vs 'Joined-but-inactive' badges correctly.
Verify iteration_3 KYC admin bugs (GET /admin/kyc 404 + PUT /admin/kyc/{id} 500) are fixed — this iteration did not re-run those tests (they were unrelated to Phase 2).
Consider making POST /api/cart/update do an upsert or return 404 when product not in cart (current no-op silent behavior is confusing).
HampersPage: When only joining kit is unlocked, verify the single hamper card renders (screenshot showed heading but no cards below — may be a filter/layout issue).
public_user is also missing `sponsor_user_id` and `terms_accepted_at` — minor, but useful for admin/user impersonation flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still >1500 lines — needs router split (cart, orders, admin sub-routes). The KYC decorator regression in iteration_3 was exactly this kind of risk.
cart/add and orders/create duplicate the join-gate + stock logic. Extract into a helper `assert_purchasable(user, product, qty)` to keep rules single-sourced.

cart/add stock check uses `p.get('stock',0)` at cart-time but stock is not decremented until verify-payment — race condition possible (two users can simultaneously add last unit and both check out). Consider stock reservation on order create or optimistic locking on payment.

process_paid_joining runs sequentially (increment sponsor → check eligibility → distribute commissions). If the same buyer's payment is verified twice concurrently, they'd double-credit. Add idempotency guard: skip if order.payment_status already == 'paid' (or track processed_payments).
public_user() omits `income_active` — either add it or document why it's hidden. It's checked in mlm_engine for commission eligibility so it's important business state.

seed.py mutates settings on every startup — fine, but `settings` doc get/upsert is not idempotent for keys like delivery_charge if admin changes them in prod (needs {'$setOnInsert':...} for defaults).
MOCKED: Razorpay verify-payment auto-succeeds without signature verification — clearly labeled but production readiness requires wiring real signature check.

rca_of_the_issue.income_active_missing_from_me: public_user() in /app/backend/server.py L83-108 explicitly whitelists the fields it returns; `income_active` is not in the whitelist even though it IS stored on the user document and used by mlm_engine._distribute_level_commissions for eligibility. Fix: add `"income_active": u.get("income_active", False)` to the return dict. Verified by direct MongoDB query — the user EG000016 has direct_referrals_count=3, income_active=True, commission_wallet=1200 (proof L1 was credited), but /auth/me returns income_active as absent.
